scenario: Capture facts are engine-internal `scope activation` per LSCP.6.6 — the compiler generates them for a call continuation. Pin: a call with an `on response` clause whose body reads `{t.entity_id}` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads no lowered output, so the capture schema is not observed.
rules_ds:
schema SvcCheckReply scope ttl 1_h:
    corr: String
    v: Int

service svc.check:
    kwarg entity_id: String
    response SvcCheckReply

schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.check entity_id: t.entity_id cooldown: 30_s
        on response.v > 0:
            log info "ok: {t.entity_id}"
